notes.title: New Splash screen
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=PqBR7ShUWNw;full][/previewyoutube]


Greetings, Steamers!

We are thrilled to announce the latest update for Orcs and Outlaws, bringing a brand-new splash screen , incorporating some of the latest Orc and demon characters.
What's New:

1. Atmospheric New Artwork:
Atmosphere is everything in this game - so we created a new splash screen featuring epic, hand-crafted lighting and visual effects. This dynamic visual sets the tone for the thrilling fantasy action that awaits you in the game. With a snapshot of some of the orc outlaws, and a landscape teeming with adventure, hopefully this artwork will give you a flavor of the dark fantasy settings in the world of Orcs and Outlaws.

2. Enhanced Audio Experience:
Alongside the new visual, we’ve integrated a powerful, cinematic soundtrack that will play during the splash screen. Composed to evoke the spirit of adventure and the clash of battle, this audio enhancement is designed to immerse the player in the game world. 

3. Optimized Loading Times:
We’ve also worked behind the scenes to ensure that the transition from splash screen to main menu is smoother and faster. Enjoy a seamless start to your gaming sessions with reduced loading times.

4. Easter Eggs:
Keep an eye out for hidden elements within any of our new screens. We’ve added a few surprises that hint at future updates and expansions. 

Community Spotlight:
We’d like to take this opportunity to thank our community for the continued support and feedback. Your passion drives us to keep improving and expanding the world of Orcs and Outlaws. Don’t forget to share your thoughts on the new splash screen here or online. 
How to Access the Update:

Stay tuned for more exciting updates and adventures in the world of Orcs and Outlaws!

Happy Gaming,
The Orcs and Outlaws Development Team
